name: OS System Health & Services
description: Monitors system resources, systemd service health, and Arch package state via D-Bus and read-only system APIs.

tools.name: system_health_summary
tools.description: Read CPU, memory, swap, disk usage, and failed systemd units.

tools.name: service_status
tools.description: Inspect the status and recent journal logs of a systemd unit.

tools.name: restart_service
tools.description: Restart a systemd service (requires explicit user confirmation and Polkit authorization).
